connector.name: Tenderapi MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for French (BOAMP) + EU (TED) public procurement data via TenderAPI.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package tenderapi-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the idnsidns account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TENDERAPI_KEY
env.description: TenderAPI key (get a free one at https://tenderapi.fr/). Sent as X-API-Key header on every REST call.

env.name: TENDERAPI_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (default: https://tenderapi.fr). Useful for dev/staging.
